facts.fact: The SMART Zambia Institute's digital literacy programme for citizens, funded by ITU and Norway, trained 243 people (56 per cent women) across six localities (Mongu, Mumbwa, Chipata, Chibombo, Kafue, Choma) from 15 July to 26 September 2024, per ITU Academy.
